import sys

def two_choose(n):
    if n < 2:
        return 0
    return n * (n - 1) // 2

def three_choose(n):
    if n < 3:
        return 0
    return n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) // 6

def get_total_combinations(n):
    return three_choose(n)

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    parts = input_line.split()
    n = int(parts[0])
    p = float(parts[1])
    total_comb = get_total_combinations(n)
    for i in range(n + 1):
        p1 = (i * two_choose(n - i)) / total_comb if total_comb != 0 else 0
        p2 = (two_choose(i) * (n - i)) / total_comb if total_comb != 0 else 0
        p3 = three_choose(i) / total_comb if total_comb != 0 else 0
        prob = p1 / 2 + p2 + p3
        if prob >= p:
            print(i)
            break

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
